thread:
Ashley: Heads-up — legal asked to see how we track consent provenance for sampled PII in logs. Need a quick proposal.
Sam: Do they want tenant-level provenance or per-request? They said 'chain of consent' for auditability.
Neha: Ideally per-request: we need a provenance header that records consent method (admin-grant, user-consent, legal-hold) + signed TTL. Minimal fields.
Jordan: UI question: if we add a 'consent provenance' column in the Console sample table, it could leak more context. Can we show an icon tooltip instead?
Ashley: Good point. Backend should include provenance in telemetry only when request is sampled for audit, not in default metrics.
Sam: Implementation thought: add X-Consent-Provenance JSON blob to the inspect payload. Runtime can redact if route flagged as 'no-provenance'.
Neha: Prefer structured fields instead of free JSON. We'll need canonical enum for method, a hex hmac for tenant, and an expiry ISO.
Jordan: UX: for canary inspect we need a compact label e.g. 'admin (ttl 24h)' with mouseover showing full record — avoid raw IDs.
Sam: Perf/quotas: adding provenance increases payload size — sampling rate will affect storage costs. Ops, what's acceptable hit?
Ashley: Finance flagged that audit samples are already ~0.05% of traffic; doubling metadata increases cost by ~8% — still within budget for next quarter.
Neha: Security: provenance must be signed by upstream with KMS key. No raw user identifiers in the blob. Pseudonymize tenant id.
Sam: For fallback routing, if provenance missing, runtime should route to a low-privilege scrubbed path and record a 'missing_provenance' flag.
Jordan: Console controls: add toggle per-tenant to opt-out of provenance display in Console (for regulated customers). Audit logs must still keep it server-side.
Ashley: Edge-case: legacy SDKs won't send header. We need a migration plan: 1) emit warning in logs, 2) map admin grants via backend lookup for older apps.
Neha: Proposal v1 fields: method=[admin,user,legal], issuer=[redwood,customer], proto_version=1, pseudonym=hmac, expires=ISO8601. Signed blob base64.
Sam: Implementation checklist: schema proto, runtime header parser, routing fallback, storage tag, console tooltip, ops metric for missing_provenance.
Jordan: Quick mock for tooltip copy: "Consent provenance — method: admin; issuer: customer; expires: 2026-05-01T12:00Z. Click to view audit." Thoughts?
Ashley: I like it. One more: add a 'min_provenance_level' route config (none/minimal/full) to reduce shipment complexity.
Neha: Agree. But require explicit tenant opt-in for 'full' to avoid accidental PII exposure.
Sam: I'll draft PR for header parsing + missing_provenance counter. Can one of you own console bits?
Jordan: I'll take the console tooltip & toggle. Will mock in Figma and link in the PR.
Ashley: Great. Neha to write schema and security review, Sam to land backend, Jordan to do UX. Ops: watch missing_provenance metric for two weeks after rollout.
Neha: I'll also add tests for signed hmac verification and TTL expiry.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled to canary cluster at 2026-04-02T03:00Z — channel #deploy-notices.
Sam: Thanks — starting the runtime sketch now. Will ping with PR link.
Jordan: +1, will attach mock.
Ashley: Closing loop — docs + migration notes in the RFC. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
